description: Iteration 3: continue the direction of it02 s02 (best, S 1.159): faster discharge for cars and motorcycles, much higher red-running probability with weak swarm term (variance/mean was 3-4), full early start, stronger sidewalk seeking, lower box jmTimegapMinor.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (sim 1.0 s vs obs 0.39 s discharge headway, R 10), M5/length (57-66 m vs 13 m) and M6 car approach times: it02 (tau 1.2, accel 1.6-2.0) cut the headway from 1.6 to 1.0 s but queues still reach 60 m, so tau goes 1.2 -> 0.7 s and accel 2.0 -> 3.0 m/s2 (minGap at its 1.0 m bound) to push discharge further toward 0.39 s. Share 0.95 leaves 0.05 for car_seeker.

Targets M1/car (sim 1.0 s vs obs 0.39 s discharge headway, R 10), M5/length (57-66 m vs 13 m) and M6 car approach times: it02 (tau 1.2, accel 1.6-2.0) cut the headway from 1.6 to 1.0 s but queues still reach 60 m, so tau goes 1.2 -> 0.7 s and accel 2.0 -> 3.0 m/s2 (minGap at its 1.0 m bound) to push discharge further toward 0.39 s. Share 0.05 keeps M9b/share_blocked (sim 0.08 vs obs 0.02) from growing; M9a was 0.26 vs 0.33.

Targets M1/moto (sim 0.63-0.67 s vs obs 0.30 s, R 18), M5/length and M5/moto_density (0.07 vs 0.045 veh/m2): it02 s02 (tau 0.5, accel 3.0, minGap 1.2) was the best, so tau goes to its 0.4 s bound, accel 3.0 -> 4.0 and minGap 1.2 -> 0.6 m for faster discharge; minGapLat stays at 0.3 m. Share 0.85 leaves 0.15 for moto_seeker.

Targets M1/moto (sim 0.63-0.67 s vs obs 0.30 s, R 18), M5/length and M5/moto_density (0.07 vs 0.045 veh/m2): it02 s02 (tau 0.5, accel 3.0, minGap 1.2) was the best, so tau goes to its 0.4 s bound, accel 3.0 -> 4.0 and minGap 1.2 -> 0.6 m for faster discharge; minGapLat stays at 0.3 m. Share 0.15 with p_sidewalk 0.12 targets M10a (sim 0.06 vs obs 0.27 veh/cycle).

Targets M7a/release_time (sim 12-37 s vs obs 2.6 s) and M7b/clear_lag (7.7-24 s vs 6.7 s): jmTimegapMinor 0.7 -> 0.5 s (lower bound) lets box waiters accept smaller gaps and leave sooner; riding values as moto_saval for M1/moto. Share 1.0 required (sole archetype).

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (sim 0.026-0.034 vs obs 0.092), M3/per_cycle (0.8-1.1 vs 4.4) and M3/var_to_mean (2.8-4.1 vs 1.31): about 25 percent of decided runners did not cross before red ended, so p0 rises 0.5 -> 0.9 to raise the share; k lowered 0.1-0.2 -> 0.02 because the swarm term over-clusters (variance/mean too high).

Targets M2/early/moto (sim 0.035-0.048 vs obs 0.13) and M2/first_delay (3.4-6.2 s vs 2.1 s): about half of the attempts ended as red_ended_before_crossing, so the window is the maximum 10 s, p 1.0 and the creep speed cap 4 m/s so riders reach the line before green.

Targets M10a (it02 s02 0.06 vs obs 0.27 veh/cycle at p_sidewalk 0.05), M9a (0.26 vs 0.33) and M9b/share_blocked (0.08 vs 0.02): p_sidewalk raised 0.05 -> 0.12 for M10a, p_right_lane lowered 0.03 -> 0.02 to cut blocked right-turners (the moto seeker share rises, which keeps M9a near target). p_wrong_lane stays 0 (inapplicable, R27).
